ex.en: The incident heightened tensions between the two neighbouring countries.
ex.zh: 这一事件加剧了两个邻国之间的紧张关系。

words.note: heighten 由 height 加 -en 构成，多与 tension 搭配。

ex.en: The city plans to ban private vehicles from the old town centre.
ex.zh: 该市计划禁止私家车进入老城中心。

words.note: vehicle 除车辆外，可喻传播工具，如 a vehicle for change。

ex.en: He scraped through the final exam with a score of just sixty.
ex.zh: 他仅以六十分的成绩勉强通过了期末考试。

words.note: scrape through 指勉强通过；scrape by 指勉强糊口。

ex.en: A spider had built a web between the two branches overnight.
ex.zh: 一只蜘蛛一夜之间在两根树枝间结了网。

words.note: web 指蛛网或网络，the Web 指万维网。

ex.en: The novel explores how traditional femininity shapes women's choices.
ex.zh: 这部小说探讨传统女性气质如何影响女性的选择。

words.note: femininity 是 feminine 的名词，指女性气质，不可数。

ex.en: Sales reached a plateau in the third quarter and stayed flat.
ex.zh: 销售额在第三季度趋于平稳并保持不动。

words.note: plateau 可指高原，也指发展后的停滞、平台期。

ex.en: The tragic accident left three families without a home.
ex.zh: 那场悲惨的事故使三个家庭失去了住所。

words.note: tragic 指悲剧性的；名词是 tragedy，注意拼写。

ex.en: He gave me a broad grin and waved from across the street.
ex.zh: 他在街对面朝我咧嘴大笑并挥手。

words.note: grin 指露齿笑；grin and bear it 意为苦笑着忍受。

ex.en: She gripped the railing tightly as the ship began to rock.
ex.zh: 船开始摇晃时，她紧紧抓住栏杆。

words.note: grip 指紧握，也可指吸引注意；get a grip on 指掌控。

ex.en: The country's heavy reliance on imported oil makes its economy fragile.
ex.zh: 该国对进口石油的严重依赖使其经济脆弱。

words.note: reliance 后接 on；动词是 rely on，形容词是 reliant。

ex.en: The team met to explore ways of cutting costs without losing quality.
ex.zh: 团队开会探讨在不降低质量的情况下削减成本的方法。

words.note: explore 后可接名词或 how、what 从句，表示探究。

ex.en: Several rare paintings are now on display in the city museum.
ex.zh: 几幅珍稀画作正在市博物馆展出。

words.note: on display 表在展出；display 也可指表现出的情绪。

ex.en: The dam generates enough electricity for half a million homes.
ex.zh: 这座大坝发的电足够五十万户家庭使用。

words.note: electricity 不可数；形容词 electric 指用电的。

ex.en: The region has a mild climate that suits tea growing.
ex.zh: 该地区气候温和，适宜种茶。

words.note: climate 指长期气候，weather 指某天天气；也可指气氛。

ex.en: The two sides reached a tentative agreement on the price.
ex.zh: 双方就价格达成了初步协议。

words.note: tentative 指试探性、暂时性的，常修饰 plan、agreement。

ex.en: The room was in complete disorder after the party.
ex.zh: 聚会结束后房间一片凌乱。

words.note: in disorder 表凌乱；disorder 也指身心失调。

ex.en: Cutting public spending could aggravate the problem of unemployment.
ex.zh: 削减公共开支可能使失业问题恶化。

words.note: aggravate 指使恶化；口语中也可指惹恼某人。

ex.en: The minister was widely criticized for his handling of the crisis.
ex.zh: 这位部长因处理危机的方式受到广泛批评。

words.note: criticize sb for sth 是常见结构；名词为 criticism。

ex.en: The mayor will preside over the opening ceremony tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 市长将于明天上午主持开幕仪式。

words.note: preside 不及物，后接 over 或 at，不直接跟宾语。

ex.en: The country has enjoyed steady economic growth over the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年该国经济保持了稳定增长。

words.note: economic 指经济的；economical 指节省的，勿混。

ex.en: The invention of the transistor changed the design of radios and computers.
ex.zh: 晶体管的发明改变了收音机和计算机的设计。

words.note: transistor 由 transfer 与 resistor 缩合而成，指晶体管。

ex.en: Recent statistics show that traffic accidents have fallen sharply.
ex.zh: 最新统计显示交通事故已大幅下降。

words.note: statistics 作统计学用单数动词，作数据用复数。

ex.en: The report paints a grim picture of the region's future.
ex.zh: 报告描绘了该地区前景的暗淡景象。

words.note: grim 指严峻、阴沉；paint a grim picture 为常用搭配。

ex.en: The girls giggled at the joke and could not stop.
ex.zh: 女孩们听了那个笑话咯咯直笑，停不下来。

words.note: giggle 指压抑的咯咯笑，比 laugh 轻且多含傻气。

ex.en: Many animals will not produce offspring when food is scarce.
ex.zh: 食物稀少时，许多动物不会繁殖后代。

words.note: offspring 单复数同形，不加 -s，也可指产物。

ex.en: The police arrested two men for stealing cars in the district.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了两名在该区偷车的男子。

words.note: arrest 也指吸引（注意）或阻止，如 arrest attention。

ex.en: The business has matured into a serious competitor in the market.
ex.zh: 该企业发展成为市场中一个不容小觑的竞争者。

words.note: mature 也可指票据、债券到期，常见于金融语境。

ex.en: The new medicine can alleviate pain without causing side effects.
ex.zh: 这种新药能减轻疼痛且不产生副作用。

words.note: alleviate 指减轻痛苦或困难，多接 pain、pressure。

ex.en: You will receive a notification when your order has been shipped.
ex.zh: 订单发货后你会收到通知。

words.note: notification 是 notify 的名词；手机消息通知即此词。

ex.en: After heavy rain, the river overflowed its banks and flooded the road.
ex.zh: 大雨后河水漫过堤岸，淹没了道路。

words.note: overflow 可指液体溢出，也指充满情绪，如 overflow with joy。
